content:
maya: Kicking off Verdant POC perf run. Goal: validate 1.8k embed qps + 200 gen qps. Posting live notes.
kevin: Whats the mix and infra?
maya: 85% embeds (seq=64), 15% gen (seq=192, max_gen=80). Pool: 4x A100-eq dedicated, model: verdant-embed-2b + verdant-gen-7b-4bit. Batching: adaptive, max_batch_tokens=6144, batch_timeout_ms=12.
sales-liz: Customer asked if we can commit p95 embed <120ms and how burst pricing works. Also asked timeline for HIPAA/KMS options.
eng-hao: Loadgen started. First 7m: sustain qps ~1.76k, embed p50=21ms p95=130ms p99=360ms. Gen p95=310ms p99=900ms.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool util 92% at 4950012360; reserved commit reached; burst not active.
maya: sample logs: 
```
[4950012365] id=E101 slot=gpu-2 qlen=7 batch_tks=5200 p95=132ms p99=358ms gpu_util=85% cache_hit=0.94 nvlink=66%
[4950012372] id=G33 slot=gpu-1 qlen=2 batch_tks=160 p95=28ms p99=92ms gpu_util=34% cache_hit=0.99 nvlink=14%
[4950012378] id=E150 slot=gpu-3 qlen=12 batch_tks=6400 p95=210ms p99=720ms gpu_util=98% cache_hit=0.61 nvlink=89%
```
eng-hao: Noticed drop in cache_hit before big p99s. Likely KV eviction when long gens interleave with embeds.
kevin: Short answer for sales: burst autoscale reduces queueing tails but won't fully eliminate cold-cache stalls. Recommend caching + pinned route for gen + burst for peaks.
infra-nina: Agreed. We can create a "gen-warm" route pinned to 1 GPU equiv and tune prefix_cache size. Also can enable burst for POC windows.
qa-sam: HIPAA/KMS: we can offer Private with customer-managed keys; SOC2 artifacts available. I'll attach checklist.
maya: Proposed immediate test: run 20m A/B: A) baseline, B) enable prefix_cache (cache_max_entries=15k) + create gen-warm route, C) same as B + burst enabled.
eng-hao: Ill also try batch_timeout_ms=7 in one sub-run to see latency jitter.
sales-liz: Can ops estimate burst cost so I can reply to customer? They asked for a per-minute ballpark.
ops-bot: cost_estimate: estimated burst ~+$0.10/min for expected 30min/day -> ~$45/month (rough).
kevin: If we show A->B drops the p95 by ~15-20% and B->C mostly reduces rare p99s, thats a clear recommendation: caching + routing first, burst for peak protection.
maya: Running A/B now. Will post condensed results here.
eng-hao: If p99 persists after these, suggest soft limit on max_gen or chunked streaming as a customer option.
ops-bot: change_request: enable_burst_autoscale(verdant-poc) submitted by maya at 4950012420  pending infra-nina approval.
infra-nina: approved. Enabling burst for the next window.
maya: Thanks  kicking off B-run. Will report back with p50/p95/p99 and recommendation slide for sales. :thumbsup:
